emailSubject: Application Update: Backend Go Developer opening
emailBody:
Hi David,

Thank you for applying for the Backend Go Developer opening at our company.

After reviewing your application, we found that your background is centered primarily around Graphic Design and WordPress, whereas this position requires specialized experience in Go (Golang) microservices and distributed backend systems.

Consequently, we won't be advancing your application for this opening. We will keep your portfolio on file should suitable UI/UX Design positions open up.

Thank you again for your time, and we wish you success with your search.

Sincerely,
Manasvi Paliwal
Recruitment Team
